digest.component_or_area: review-bot event persistence and ticket clone management
propositions: Two untracked event JSON files exist in the persistent review-bot tickets clone predating the A6-0b deployment while HEAD equals refs/remotes/origin/tickets
The TICKET_DIGEST file is a superseded unsigned derived-cache sidecar with older timestamp than authoritative committed digests and cannot become canonical
The CLAIM_ENRICH file is an expired lease queue residue with expiry time predating inspection time and a later superseding claim in authoritative history
Untracked event files must be classified as unique recoverable data, duplicates of committed events, or disposable residue before any history rewrite could strand or overwrite them

After authorized disposal of both files conditional on matching hashes and exact git status, the persistent clone must verify clean with no untracked event files and HEAD equalling refs/remotes/origin/tickets
